title.zh: v2.2.4 真正去掉黄色：极光冷色底 + 每个曲风一张自己的封面图；并移除「拿去即兴」
title.en: v2.2.4 Amber Actually Gone: an Aurora Ground, a Cover Per Genre, and No Jam Hand-Off

highlights.zh: **先承认一件事**：v2.2.1 声称换了配色，但那次改动**没有真正写进 `mobile.css`**（脚本替换静默失败，我只验证了「构建通过」而没验证「琥珀色字符串已消失」）。所以线上一直是那套屎黄色——这一版是真正生效的一次：冷调近黑底（#0b0b14）、中性白文字、默认强调色青绿，模块配色为 即兴 紫 / 挑战 玫瑰 / 探索 蓝 / 更多 灰，并且**验证了 `#e9a23b` 在样式里为 0 次出现**。
highlights.en: **One admission first**: v2.2.1 claimed a new palette but the change **never reached `mobile.css`** (the scripted replacement failed silently, and I verified the build rather than the amber string). The live build stayed amber; this one is real: a cool near-black ground (#0b0b14), neutral white ink, teal default accent, and per-module accents (jam violet / challenge rose / explore blue / more slate) — with `#e9a23b` verified to appear **zero** times in the stylesheet.

highlights.zh: **每个曲风有自己的封面图**：按你给的参考图的极光质感（紫 → 粉 → 青，深色底、多层径向光晕）**程序化生成**——同一曲风永远同一张、不同曲风互不相同、六个类别各有色相带。同时留了**真实图片的入口**：把 `<genre-id>.jpg` 放进 `public/covers/` 就会自动覆盖生成图，不需要改代码。**没有直接塞入真实照片**，是因为这个环境离线、且 159 张图的版权归属需要你来定；生成图今天就能用，真实图随时可替换。
highlights.en: **Every genre gets its own cover**: generated from the aurora look in your reference (violet → pink → teal over a dark ground, layered radial glows) — the same genre always looks the same, different genres differ, and each of the six categories has its own hue band. There is also a **real-image hook**: drop `<genre-id>.jpg` into `public/covers/` and it takes over automatically, no code change. Real photographs are not bundled because this environment is offline and 159 image…

highlights.zh: **「拿去即兴」已按你的要求移除**：曲风详情页不再有任何按钮（除了左上角的返回），点页面任意非链接处也能返回。
highlights.en: **The jam hand-off is gone, as asked**: a genre's page now has no buttons at all besides the back arrow, and tapping anywhere that is not a link also returns.
